title: EdifactParser message
description: The shape produced by TransactionMessage::toArray()/toJson(). Segment entries match the shape produced by SegmentArray::fromSegment().

type.description: Message type from the UNH segment, or null when the message has no UNH.

segments.description: Every segment in document order, duplicates preserved.

subId.description: Identifier distinguishing repeated segments with the same tag. Composite ids are joined with ':'.

rawValues.description: The segment's elements. Element 0 is the tag; each other entry is either a simple value or a list of components.

children.description: Present only on context segments: the segments grouped under this one.

element.description: A simple element (string) or a composite (list of components).
